Subiect: New payment methods coming to Link starting January 7, 2027

Conținut:
New payment methods coming to Link

Starting January 7, 2027, Link (https://stripe.com/payments/link), Stripe’s digital wallet, will enable additional payment methods with transparent pricing. Link connects you to over 300 million buyers worldwide and is used by over 1 million businesses, including OpenAI, Etsy, and Uber. It helps your customers check out up to 3x faster.

What you need to know

Payment methods

Link now supports global payment options like Pix (Brazil), in addition to cards. Businesses that offer at least one payment method beyond cards see an average 12% lift in revenue (https://stripe.com/blog/testing-the-conversion-impact-of-50-plus-global-payment-methods), and Link intelligently surfaces the optimal payment method based on criteria such as location, amount, currency, MCC, and likelihood to convert.

Pricing

Unlike traditional wallets, Link passes cost savings back to businesses when consumers use lower-cost payment methods. The pricing per payment method is:

- Pix: 1.5% + 0.25 EUR per successful transaction plus 1.5% for international transactions and 1% if currency conversion is required

- Cards: There are no changes to rates for cards

(Link checkout showing Instant Bank Payments, cards, Pix, and UPI as payment options [https://b.stripecdn.com/link-email/assets/ibp_credit_pix_upi.png]) A customer can choose their preferred payment methods.

How to opt out

To turn off any payment method through Link, you’ll need to turn off Link altogether.

Learn more about payment methods on Link in our docs (https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/link-payment-methods) when signed in to your Stripe account. If you have questions, visit Stripe support (https://support.stripe.com/) or reply to this email.

memorii.titlu: [GMAIL] Scoped API keys: a change coming on 2 December
memorii.detalii:
De la: DeepInfra <newsletter@deepinfra.com>
ID Gmail: 1a1efa1e899c9044
Thread: 1a1efa1e899c9044
Data: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 17:01:27 +0000
Subiect: Scoped API keys: a change coming on 2 December

Conținut:
From 2 December, new API keys need an explicit scope list. Here’s what changes.  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://deepinfra.com November 2026

DeepInfra has rolled out scoped API keys! Below: what scopes do, a change to key creation coming on 2 December, and how to limit the keys you already have.
API key scopes


** Scoped API keys are live.
------------------------------------------------------------

Since 3 November, you can specify scopes when you create an API key. Scopes limit the actions that key can successfully perform.

Every existing scope is described in our documentation. In the API reference, each endpoint that accepts API key authentication is annotated with the scope it needs. Scoped JWTs created from an API key are limited to the scopes of the key that created them.

See all scopes → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#scopes)

Example endpoint in the API reference → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/api-reference/account/me)
Change on 2 December


** Key creation will require a scope list.
------------------------------------------------------------

In the first days after the rollout, requests to create an API key with no scopes specified were accepted, and those keys were made unrestricted. An unrestricted key has every non-sensitive scope, including scopes we add later.

In two weeks, on 2 December, API key creation requests that don’t specify scopes will be rejected. If you still need unrestricted behavior, send an explicit scope list of ["unrestricted"]. unrestricted has to be the only value in the list, or the request fails with a 422. These calls are already supported today, so you can update your integration now.

More on unrestricted keys → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#unrestricted-keys)
Existing keys


** You can edit a key’s scopes.
------------------------------------------------------------

A key’s scopes are editable. Keys created before scopes existed are unrestricted. To limit one, open it in API key management in the DeepInfra dashboard, switch it to Scoped, and pick the scopes it needs.

Kind regards,

— The DeepInfra team

Payment methods

memorii.detalii:
De la: DeepInfra <newsletter@deepinfra.com>

Thread: 1a1efa1e899c9044

Subiect: Scoped API keys: a change coming on 2 December

Conținut:
From 2 December, new API keys need an explicit scope list. Here’s what changes.  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://deepinfra.com November 2026

DeepInfra has rolled out scoped API keys! Below: what scopes do, a change to key creation coming on 2 December, and how to limit the keys you already have.
API key scopes


** Scoped API keys are live.
------------------------------------------------------------

Since 3 November, you can specify scopes when you create an API key. Scopes limit the actions that key can successfully perform.

Every existing scope is described in our documentation. In the API reference, each endpoint that accepts API key authentication is annotated with the scope it needs. Scoped JWTs created from an API key are limited to the scopes of the key that created them.

See all scopes → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#scopes)

Example endpoint in the API reference → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/api-reference/account/me)
Change on 2 December


** Key creation will require a scope list.
------------------------------------------------------------

In the first days after the rollout, requests to create an API key with no scopes specified were accepted, and those keys were made unrestricted. An unrestricted key has every non-sensitive scope, including scopes we add later.

In two weeks, on 2 December, API key creation requests that don’t specify scopes will be rejected. If you still need unrestricted behavior, send an explicit scope list of ["unrestricted"]. unrestricted has to be the only value in the list, or the request fails with a 422. These calls are already supported today, so you can update your integration now.

More on unrestricted keys → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#unrestricted-keys)
Existing keys


** You can edit a key’s scopes.
------------------------------------------------------------

A key’s scopes are editable. Keys created before scopes existed are unrestricted. To limit one, open it in API key management in the DeepInfra dashboard, switch it to Scoped, and pick the scopes it needs.

Subiect: Scoped API keys: a change coming on 2 December

Conținut:
From 2 December, new API keys need an explicit scope list. Here’s what changes.  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://deepinfra.com November 2026

DeepInfra has rolled out scoped API keys! Below: what scopes do, a change to key creation coming on 2 December, and how to limit the keys you already have.
API key scopes


** Scoped API keys are live.
------------------------------------------------------------

Since 3 November, you can specify scopes when you create an API key. Scopes limit the actions that key can successfully perform.

Every existing scope is described in our documentation. In the API reference, each endpoint that accepts API key authentication is annotated with the scope it needs. Scoped JWTs created from an API key are limited to the scopes of the key that created them.

See all scopes → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#scopes)

Example endpoint in the API reference → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/api-reference/account/me)
Change on 2 December


** Key creation will require a scope list.
------------------------------------------------------------

In the first days after the rollout, requests to create an API key with no scopes specified were accepted, and those keys were made unrestricted. An unrestricted key has every non-sensitive scope, including scopes we add later.

In two weeks, on 2 December, API key creation requests that don’t specify scopes will be rejected. If you still need unrestricted behavior, send an explicit scope list of ["unrestricted"]. unrestricted has to be the only value in the list, or the request fails with a 422. These calls are already supported today, so you can update your integration now.

More on unrestricted keys → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#unrestricted-keys)
Existing keys


** You can edit a key’s scopes.
------------------------------------------------------------

A key’s scopes are editable. Keys created before scopes existed are unrestricted. To limit one, open it in API key management in the DeepInfra dashboard, switch it to Scoped, and pick the scopes it needs.

Kind regards,

— The DeepInfra team
